title: Rotated Screen
description: A Minecraft Post Effect that rotates your screen by 15°. Disclaimer: Only works on "Fabulous!" graphics mode.
body:
This is a resourcepack that modifies Minecraft's Transparency Post Effect. It rotates the screen by 15°.
It's not a lot, but enough to mentally drive you insane if you play with it long enough.

### ❗Disclaimer: This resource pack only works with the "Fabulous!" graphics setting enabled.


**⚠️Warning: This resource pack may crash your game when toggling on or off the "Fabulous!" graphics setting. Play at your own risk.**
